messages:
sarah-cse: Customer AcmeCorp reporting intermittent 502s + streaming timeouts since 09:17 UTC. SDK is entering retry loop and they're seeing duplicated billable units. Request IDs: rQf9-312, rQf9-314. Region: eu-west-1. Can we triage and provide a mitigation asap?

dani: looking. can you paste the SDK logs from the client + any curl attempt? also is this only streaming endpoints or regular generate too?

sarah-cse: user says streaming primarily but they also saw a few short-lived 502s on /v1/generate. attaching snippet they sent: 
> client: node sdk v2.1.1, retries enabled, backoff default
> error: \"upstream 502 during chunked response\"

mike: pinging edge logs for eu-west-1. I'll grep for those req ids. if this is connection eviction we might see \"connection reset by peer\" in the proxy logs.

ingrid: I see a p95 latency spike on the gateway at 09:16-09:19 UTC. partial log tail (redacted):
```
2026-03-17T09:17:02Z router-1 eu-west-1 rQf9-312 502 upstream_reset: conn_evicted
2026-03-17T09:17:05Z router-2 eu-west-1 rQf9-314 502 write_timeout: stream_closed
2026-03-17T09:17:09Z router-1 eu-west-1 rQf9-319 200 ok
```
noting multiple conn_evicted entries around that window.

ops-bot: deploy history for eu-west-1: rollback to tagged build 2026-03-17T08:50 applied at 09:22 UTC. No config changes.

dani: repro steps i'm running locally:
```bash
# streaming repro with curl (chunked)
curl -i -N -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large","prompt":"hello","stream":true, "max_tokens":512}'
```
node snippet we've seen from customer:
```js
const r = await client.stream.create({ model: 'redwood-large', prompt: 'hi', stream: true });
for await (const chunk of r) { console.log(chunk); }
```
I can repro a truncated stream followed by 502 when I throttle connections locally.

julia-eng: likely causes: 1) upstream instance eviction under high i/o, 2) keepalive mismatch causing half-closed sockets, 3) SDK retry window too aggressive causing duplicate requests. quick mitigation: reduce SDK concurrent streaming connections and set keepAlive: true in client config. also propose temporary model fallback to smaller variant for AcmeCorp to reduce token egress.

mike: confirming ingress qdepth rose to 85% on a subset of routers at that timeframe. circuit breaker on the gateway kicked but didn't fully block, so a mix of partial writes + eviction looks consistent. we'll increase the CB threshold to shed traffic for 10m while we patch.

dani: proposed customer-facing msg (please edit):
> Hey AcmeCorp — we're seeing intermittent 502s and short streaming interruptions in eu-west-1 this morning. We're actively throttling a subset of gateway routes to prevent retries from escalating the issue and will temporarily enable a smaller model fallback to reduce streaming bursts. Expect lower throughput but stable streaming while we patch. ETA for a stable fix: ~2 hours. We'll keep you updated.

sarah-cse: LGTM, send that now and offer a one-time token credit for the duplicated units. they asked for ETA.

ingrid: root cause hypothesis: an edge proxy connection-eviction bug under sustained high write stall conditions. patch in review to add a stricter keepalive probe and backpressure on writer queue. target deploy in 1.5 hours, hotfix backport to current stable within 3 hours.

mike: mitigation actions I'm taking now:
- increase circuit-breaker drop ratio for streaming route to 0.6 for 10m
- enable per-tenant fallback to redwood-medium for AcmeCorp
- kick a rolling restart of the affected router group (staggered)
will monitor. :eyes:

support-bot: Incident INC-2026-4423 created: https://incidents.redwood.example/INC-2026-4423 — assigned to eng-runtime. Priority: P2.

dani: i've pushed the customer comms. sent to AcmeCorp at 09:28 UTC with the temporary fallback enabled. monitoring metrics now show fewer retries from their tenant id.

sarah-cse: customer replied: thanks, they see steadier stream but asked us to confirm billing adjustment. I'll create billing ticket and loop in finance.

ingrid: patch merged to main at 09:40 UTC, rolling hotfix to eu-west-1 now. will post live update when routers finish cycle.

mike: update: routers finished restart at 09:51 UTC, p95 for streaming path back to baseline. marking this thread for postmortem.

dani: note for postmortem: include SDK guidance to set keepAlive + exponential jittered backoff for streaming, and add a monitoring alert on conn_evicted rate > 5/min.

sarah-cse: thanks all. i'll follow up with the customer on billing and share the postmortem when ready. :thumbsup:
